rendered:
The V2O5 film thicknesses tested electrochemically were ∼80 nm and ∼40 nm. 

The ∼80 nm film was obtained after 1000 ALD cycles, while the ∼40 nm film was obtained after 250 ALD cycles.

The potential shifts did not differ between the two film thicknesses, as shown in the Supporting Information (Figure S14).
